Flannel up, distortion up — Les-Be-Emo is turning the Patio into a full-blown lesbian music & arts feastival 🎸🖤

This one's got layers: live bands, a drag show, and a night market all under one roof (well, patio). Summerache, Porch Cat, and Moonstruck bring the riffs back to back to back while DJ Dea keeps the night bleeding between sets.

Grunge nostalgia meets Latinx energy meets your favorite people screaming lyrics into the summer air. Feastival vibes, mosh-adjacent moves, emo tears optional.

This is not a drill — this is a whole scene.

📅 Saturday, August 22, 2026 | Live music starts at 5PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10 door
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #LesBeEmo #PascoWA #LiveMusic #DragShow #NightMarket #GrungeNight #LatinxNightlife

Three bands. One drag show. A night market. And enough eyeliner to fuel a whole scene 🖤🎤

Les-Be-Emo isn't just a show, it's a full sensory takeover — riffs bouncing off the patio walls, drag looks serving next to vendor tables, and DJ Dea filling every gap so the energy never dips.

Summerache, Porch Cat, and Moonstruck each bring their own flavor of distortion, and by the time the night's done you'll have a new favorite band and sore vocal cords from singing along.

Come for the music, stay for everything else.

7PM. The riffs get heavier. Porch Cat takes the stage 🐈‍⬛🎸

That crescent moon and skull logo isn't just cool merch — it's a warning that things are about to get atmospheric. Porch Cat closes out the live music lineup at Les-Be-Emo, bringing the distortion pit to its peak right before the night fully shifts into drag show and night market mode.

Get there early, hold your spot, because this is the set the whole patio's been waiting for.

📅 Saturday, August 22, 2026 | Porch Cat at 7PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10 door
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #LesBeEmo #PorchCat #LiveMusic #PascoWA #GrungeNight #LatinxNightlife

5PM sharp — Moonstruck kicks off Les-Be-Emo and sets the tone for the whole night 🌙🤘

They're first up on the bill, which means they're the ones who get to crack the night wide open. Expect the riffs to hit hard right out the gate as the patio fills in and the distortion pit comes alive.

If you're only catching one set before the market and drag show take over, make it this one — Moonstruck doesn't ease you in.

📅 Saturday, August 22, 2026 | Moonstruck at 5PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10 door
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #LesBeEmo #Moonstruck #LiveMusic #PascoWA #GrungeNight #LatinxNightlife

6PM — Summerache takes over the patio and keeps the distortion pit rolling 🎤🖤

Right in the sweet spot of the night, between the opener and the closer, Summerache brings their own edge to the Les-Be-Emo lineup. This is the set where the crowd's warmed up, the flannel's already coming off, and everyone's ready to feel it.

Don't be late — the middle set is always the one people talk about after.
